original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州青年抗议道路重建延期
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州西部青年在阿贝奥库塔-奥洛伦达-伊梅科公路沿线集会，抗议该道路状况恶劣且重建承诺迟迟未落实。抗议者举牌要求州长兑现2026年1月的重建承诺。据单一来源报道，青年组织呼吁州政府提供项目进展说明并采取具体行动。

location.raw_text: Alamala axis of the expressway, Ogun West, Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州西部青年在公路沿线集会抗议道路状况恶劣
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The youths gathered in their numbers along the Alamala axis of the expressway on Saturday to protest the deplorable state of the road

key_facts.fact: 抗议者要求州长兑现2026年1月作出的道路重建承诺
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urged the Ogun State Government to fulfil its January 2026 promise to reconstruct the Abeokuta–Olorunda–Imeko Road
some of them carrying placards with inscriptions such as “Good road is our right, not a privilege,”

key_facts.fact: 青年组织呼吁州政府提供项目进展说明
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urged Governor Dapo Abiodun to provide an update on the project and take concrete steps towards its implementation

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
抗议参与人数未获确认
